thread:
deploy-bot: Request: temporary runtime pin on api-prod to runtime v2.21.3 for a 90m hold (22:30-00:00 PT). Canary showed p99 tail regressions after a micro-optimizer landed. Filing INF-5177, tagging @eng-runtime and @ops.

rachel: Quick ask  drop the canary numbers? need to justify to product.

tom: Canary canary-opt-20260422 shows p99 720ms -> 1.4s, median unchanged, errors steady. Looks like the new allocator path increases KV-cache cold misses.

ops: I can reserve the window and run rollback. Runbook for rollback to v2.21.1: 
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.21.1
./scripts/drain_and_warm.sh --pool api-prod --model default
curl -f https://api-prod.internal/health || echo "health failed"
```

rachel: Preference: try pin first, monitor 15m, then either keep or rollback. I'll add a note to release-notes and ping CS.

tom: Add automated guard: if p99 averaged over 3 consecutive 1m windows increases >10% vs pre-pin baseline, trigger ops rollback. Also tag the deploy to pause autoscaling during observation.

docs-bot: Draft release-note snippet ready: "Temporary runtime pin to v2.21.1 applied to mitigate post-optimizer tail latency; see INF-5177 for details."

deploy-bot: Pin scheduled at 22:30 PT. Will post when applied.

deploy-bot: Pin applied at 22:32 PT: runtime pinned to v2.21.1 on api-prod. Post-pin p99=740ms (improved vs unpinned 1.4s). Monitoring 15m. No rollback needed so far.

rachel: Monitoring fine after 30m. Ops leaving window open until 00:00 PT, will unpin after if stable.

deploy-bot: Unpin action at 23:58 PT: runtime unpinned and allowed to roll forward. INF-5177 closed with follow-up to schedule optimizer revert in next sprint for deeper fix.
